vocabulary.meaning_en: arrange to have a room, seat or ticket for a later time
vocabulary.example: I need to book a hotel room for our visitor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an arrangement to keep a room or table for you
vocabulary.example: I'd like to make a reservation, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: whether something is free to use
vocabulary.example: Could you check availability for next Monday?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the price for a period of time, for example one night
vocabulary.example: The nightly rate is £100.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a lower price than usual
vocabulary.example: Do you offer a special rate for companies?

vocabulary.meaning_en: have something as part of the total
vocabulary.example: Does the price include breakfast?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a light breakfast of bread, cereal, tea or coffee
vocabulary.example: The hotel serves a continental breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: rooms, equipment or services provided for people
vocabulary.example: Are there any business facilities?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a wireless internet connection
vocabulary.example: Is there free wi-fi in the rooms?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hotel room for one person
vocabulary.example: He wants a single room with one bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hotel room with two single beds
vocabulary.example: We only have twin rooms left.

vocabulary.meaning_en: of the highest quality (for hotels)
vocabulary.example: The boss always stays in a five-star hotel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who stays in a hotel
vocabulary.example: The guest asked for an extra towel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person who answers phones and greets visitors at a hotel or office
vocabulary.example: The receptionist confirmed my booking.

vocabulary.meaning_en: start or continue doing something that was planned
vocabulary.example: I'd like to go ahead and make the reservation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: difficult to please; wanting things exactly right
vocabulary.example: Our manager is very fussy about his coffee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a way that surprises people
vocabulary.example: The director arrived unexpectedly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: just in time, at the last moment
vocabulary.example: We finished the report in the nick of time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: advice that something is good
vocabulary.example: Thanks for the hotel recommendation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: give money for something
vocabulary.example: How would you like to pay?

fine_lines.title: single room vs twin room vs double room
fine_lines.explanation_ar: single غرفة لشخص واحد، twin غرفة بسريرين منفصلين، double غرفة بسرير واحد كبير لشخصين.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Single: one bed for one person. Twin: two separate beds. Double: one big bed for two people.

examples.sentence: I'd like a single room for one night.
Two colleagues can share a twin room.
A double room has one large bed.

fine_lines.title: book vs reserve
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الفعلان بمعنى يحجز، وreserve أكثر رسمية قليلًا. والاسم منهما booking وreservation.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean arrange to have a room or seat. Reserve is a little more formal. Nouns: booking, reservation.

examples.sentence: Can you book a table for four?
I'd like to reserve a room for Friday.

expressions.phrase: Hello, I'd like to check availability and prices for a room, please.
expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا، أودّ الاستعلام عن توفّر غرفة وأسعارها من فضلك.
expressions.meaning_en: Ask if a room is free and how much it costs.
expressions.example: Hello, I'd like to check availability and prices for a room, please, for two nights.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask if breakfast is in the price.
expressions.example: The room is £90. Does the price include breakfast?

expressions.phrase: Are there any business facilities such as internet and wi-fi?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل توجد مرافق للأعمال مثل الإنترنت والواي فاي؟
expressions.example: I need to work there. Are there any business facilities such as internet and wi-fi?

expressions.phrase: I'd like to go ahead and make the reservation, please.
expressions.meaning_en: Confirm that you want to book.
expressions.example: That sounds perfect. I'd like to go ahead and make the reservation, please.

expressions.phrase: Could you offer me a special rate?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنكم أن تقدموا لي سعرًا خاصًا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ask politely for a lower price.
expressions.example: We book with you often. Could you offer me a special rate?

expressions.phrase: How would you like to pay?
expressions.meaning_en: The hotel asks about the payment method.
expressions.example: How would you like to pay, by card or in cash?

expressions.meaning_en: Say how long you will stay.
expressions.example: I need a room for three nights from tonight.

grammar.title: I'd like to + verb (polite requests)
grammar.explanation_ar: I'd like to اختصار I would like to، وهي طريقة مهذبة ورسمية للطلب بدلًا من I want. بعدها فعل مجرد.
grammar.explanation_en: I'd like to = I would like to. It is a polite, formal way to say what you want (better than I want). Use the base verb after it.
examples: I'd like to make a reservation.
I'd like to pay by card.

grammar.title: Questions with Does / Are there
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال عن الخدمات: Does + الفاعل المفرد + فعل مجرد (Does the price include...?)، وAre there any + اسم جمع؟ للسؤال عن وجود أشياء.
grammar.explanation_en: To ask about services: Does + singular subject + base verb? Are there any + plural noun? asks if things exist.
examples: Does the room have a desk?

questions.question: Which phrase asks if a room is free?
choices: How would you like to pay?
questions.explanation_ar: check availability تعني الاستعلام عن التوفّر.
questions.explanation_en: Check availability means ask if a room is free.

questions.question: Does the price ___ breakfast?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد does نستخدم الفعل المجرد include.
questions.explanation_en: After does we use the base verb: include.

questions.question: A room with two separate beds is a...
questions.explanation_en: A twin room has two single beds.

questions.question: "I'd like to go ahead and make the ___."
questions.explanation_en: After 'the' we need a noun: reservation.

questions.question: Internet, wi-fi and meeting rooms are business...
The nightly ___ is £100.
questions.explanation_en: Rate is the price per night.

questions.question: Choose the most polite request.
choices: I'd like to book a room, please.
questions.explanation_ar: I'd like to ... please هي الصيغة المهذبة.
questions.explanation_en: I'd like to ..., please is the polite form.
